parrafo_1.es: Glow Up es un head spa japonés en Doral. Martha y su equipo cuidan cada detalle del tratamiento, desde el masaje de cuero cabelludo hasta el facial final.
parrafo_1.en: Glow Up is a Japanese head spa in Doral. Martha and her team take care of every detail of the treatment, from the scalp massage to the finishing facial.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas lo dicen una y otra vez: un lugar relajante, atención genuina y resultados que se notan desde la primera visita.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews say it again and again: a relaxing place, genuine care, and results you can see from the very first visit.

texto.es: Sales con el cuero cabelludo o la piel visiblemente renovados. Las clientas lo notan de inmediato.

texto.es: Rituales pensados para cuidar la raíz del cabello y reducir el estrés.

texto.es: Manicura y pedicura con productos profesionales, en el mismo espacio.
texto.en: Manicure and pedicure with professional products, in the same space.

pie.es: ¿Buscas algo específico para tu piel o cabello? Escríbenos, seguro tenemos el tratamiento ideal.

items.quote: 10/10 experience! I absolutely loved this Japanese Head Spa. Martha was incredibly kind and attentive from the moment I arrived. The whole place feels peaceful and relaxing. I would definitely come back and also recommend it!

I had an amazing facial with Martica and couldn't be happier with the experience! She was professional, kind, and made me feel comfortable from start to finish. My skin felt incredibly clean, smooth, and glowing afterward.
Absolutely amazing experience! This scalp treatment was incredibly relaxing and the perfect way to unwind and de-stress. From beginning to end, everything was beautiful and so thoughtfully done.
